MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 81

2. Solve for x: x + 9 = 21. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 12
   C. 13
   D. 21

3. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 22
   D. 11

4. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 73
   C. 17
   D. 1

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 43
   C. 49
   D. 31

6. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 24
   D. 2

7. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 24
   D. 48

8. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

9. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

10. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 82

11. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 5

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 49

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

====

1. D — 81
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 9 × 9
3. Area = 81
Final Answer: 81 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. Substitute values: x = 21 − 9

Final Answer: x = 12
